vulnerable.description: SELECT * returns every column of Users, including password, into the tool result.

control.description: Identical to the base control: only userId and username are selected.

data_flow.sink: Tool observation returned to the LLM; dispatch is simulated in the validation harness.

validation.summary: Same behavioural test as the base case, run on this variant: the attack or leak happens only with the vulnerable file and normal use works with both.

assumptions: Read-only GetCurrentUser tool response is exposed to the agent as a tool observation.
Current user is fixed at 1 by the original wrapper; tool argument is ignored.
Password is confidential and unnecessary for transaction assistance.
TestDb replaces connection lifecycle only; real SQLite query, serialization, wrapper and registration execute.
limitations: No live LLM inference or public leakage is demonstrated.
Authentication and storage security are outside this reduced case.
This fixture does not certify the original application safe.
Both variants remain in the same application group as the first pilot case.
Refactored variant of dvla_sensitive_tool_result_001: same application group and same split; it is not an independent sample.
